title: Lift perfect residue charts on one fixed stratum
statement: Let T be Noetherian, E/Q_l a finite extension with integral coefficient datum d, and K intrinsically complete over d.completedRing T. Fix an immersion g:S→T with S locally Noetherian and quasi-compact. Let C be a cochain complex of finite-coefficient module sheaves realizing the exponent-one reduction of K through the actual finiteRingComparison. Suppose an etale cover of S gives perfect constant residue-field complex models for the finite-coefficient pullback of Q(C). Then a covering proetale sieve of S has perfect integral-complex models for K restricted through g, in exactly the integralLocalDerived and integralConstantDerived conventions of [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models]. The stratum S and g stay fixed. There is no global stratification, global reduction bound, or compatible-origin conclusion.

proof.text: Scalar restriction along a coefficient isomorphism is an equivalence on every slice. It commutes with ordinary slice restriction by the identity on sections. Localize that square, then conjugate by the canonical representative restriction comparisons. Full faithfulness reflects the composed isomorphism to exactly integralLocalDerived(g,K) ≅ integralLocalDerived(g,integralConstantDerived_T(Q)). This is the proved private sliceCoefficient_reflects lemma; S and g stay fixed. The existing finite-perfect-model infrastructure supplies the standard derived localizations on ring sheaves and their slices.

theorem integralResidueStratum_lift
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived T (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
    (hcomplete : PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) K)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [CompactSpace S]
    (g : S ⟶ T) [IsImmersion g]
    (𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage S)
    (C : CochainComplex
      (FiniteCoefficientModules T (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)) ℤ)
    (eC : Nonempty
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (AdicCoefficients.finiteRingComparison T
          (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)).hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≅
        (pbcCompletedReduction T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0).obj K))
    (hmodels : ∀ j : 𝒰.I₀,
      ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)) ℤ,
        @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0) _
          (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ∧
        Nonempty
          ((finiteCoefficientDerivedPullback T (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)
            (𝒰.f j ≫ g)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≅
            (finiteCoefficientRealization (𝒰.X j)
              (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                  (((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (𝒰.X j))
                  (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) 0))).mapHomologicalComplex
                      (.up ℤ)).obj P)))) :
    ∃ V : Sieve (⊤_ S.ProEt), V ∈ ProEt.topology S (⊤_ S.ProEt) ∧
      ∀ (U : S.ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ S.ProEt), V f →
        ∃ P : completedConstantDerived (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcIntegralRing l E)),
          @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex (PbcIntegralRing l E) _
            (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) P ∧
          Nonempty (integralLocalDerived g (pbcAdicCompletion T (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) U K ≅
            integralLocalDerived g (pbcAdicCompletion T (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) U
              ((integralConstantDerived T (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).obj P))
